questions.question: How is King Ahaz described?
options: He was righteous and faithfully trusted the LORD throughout all of his days
He walked in the ways of the kings of Israel and made idols for the Baals
He was wise and constantly sought out the counsel of all the prophets
He was peaceful and steadily built up the fortified cities of Judah
questions.answer: He walked in the ways of the kings of Israel and made idols for the Baals

questions.question: What did the prophet Oded persuade the Israelites to do with the captives of Judah?
options: Put them to death by the sword
Keep them as servants in Israel
Sell them in the slave markets
